stops.note: Dutch traders' word for a citrus punch drink, encountered through contact in the East Indies
reborrowed and blended with native 'su' (vinegar) to name a tart citrus sauce
from Dutch 'pons', punch, from traders at Dejima in Nagasaki
stops.meaning: a tart citrus and soy dipping sauce

current_meaning: a tart Japanese sauce made from citrus juice, vinegar, and soy sauce
